# LinkLang — Polish-English Translation and Interpreting

> LinkLang provides human-delivered Polish-English translation and interpreting. Based in Banff, Scotland, with in-person services within 50 miles of Banff and remote services throughout the United Kingdom. The website supports Polish and English.

## Services and indicative prices

- Document translation: Polish to English and English to Polish, including contracts, certificates and medical documents. From £35; the final quote depends on length and deadline.
- In-person interpreting: appointments with public institutions, healthcare providers, employers and solicitors, within 50 miles of Banff. From £60 for the first hour, then £15 per additional 15 minutes.
- Phone and video interpreting: available UK-wide via Zoom, Teams or WhatsApp. From £30 for the first 30 minutes, then £15 per additional 15 minutes.
- Public-services language support: interpreting questions and the client's answers for Universal Credit, HMRC, Jobcentre Plus and NHS. The service does not complete forms on the client's behalf.
- Business language support: HR documents, onboarding, site visits, health-and-safety audits and meetings. Retainer arrangements may be agreed.

## Location and coverage

- Base: Banff, Aberdeenshire, Scotland, United Kingdom.
- In-person service: within a 50-mile radius of Banff; confirm the appointment location when requesting a quote.
- Remote service: throughout the UK.
- Languages: Polish and English.

## Enquiries and ordering

- [Website and contact form](https://linklang.co.uk/): view the offer and send an enquiry.
- [Support centre](https://linklang.co.uk/support): help with services, quotes, accounts, payment and privacy, in Polish and English.
- Email: hello@linklang.co.uk
- Phone: +44 7770 110735
- Online orders, document uploads and payments use the authenticated client account. An enquiry alone does not commit the client to a purchase.

## Service limits and privacy

- LinkLang is not a sworn translator. Requests requiring certified translations for a court, the Home Office or a civil registry are referred to a certified partner.
- Documents do not go into an AI translation system. Infrastructure, email and payment providers may process information as described in the privacy policy.
- Before sending medical records or criminal-offence information, contact LinkLang to agree whether the order can be accepted and how to provide the material. Health-data orders require separate explicit consent.
- [Privacy policy](https://linklang.co.uk/privacy)
- [Terms and conditions](https://linklang.co.uk/terms)
- [Resource discovery manifest](https://linklang.co.uk/.well-known/ard.json)

These are public service-information resources. LinkLang does not advertise an MCP server, an A2A agent or an unauthenticated ordering API. Prices and availability must be confirmed with LinkLang.
